name: Rasht
about: Rasht draws nine colors from Nasim Bahari's illustration of Municipality Square on a spring afternoon. Deep violet and two blues lead into neighboring red and orange roof colors, two greens from the palms, and the lavender paving and pale architectural details.
story: Bahari's illustration looks across Rasht's Municipality Square toward its clock-fronted building. People walk, cycle, and pause among the trees and fountain. Layers of red and blue roofs frame the square. The artist described it as an afternoon on a spring day in Rasht.
notes: deep violet in the building outlines and small shadowed details
slate blue in the roof and architectural shadows
clear blue roofs and the central fountain
warm orange roof details, trunks, and clothing
deep green of the palms and planted edges
lighter green in the palms and planted edges
lavender of the broad square pavement
pale lilac in walls and roof details

source.title: Rasht Municipality Square, a spring afternoon
